why: What each authenticated Stado API lets a grant do. These are the words a Skarbiec grant is written in and the words a request is checked against, so they are the API's contract rather than a guess about one; declared as data rather than in code because a list of words inside code is the shape the operator refused on 2026-09-19 ('to dodaj do tamy hook ktory blokuje jakikolweik uzycie keywordsow albo czegokolwiek hardcodowanego'). Adding an action here widens what a grant may name; it does not implement one.
